initiatives.name: Climate and Sustainability Initiatives
initiatives.summary: NatWest provided £61.9 billion in climate and sustainable funding towards their £100 billion target between July 2021 and end of 2025. In 2023 alone, they contributed £29.3 billion to this target.

evidence.title: Climate and Sustainable Funding Progress

evidence.title: Climate Risk Integration in IFRS 9 Reporting
evidence.summary: NatWest Group integrated climate policy and technology-related transition assumptions into its base case macroeconomic scenario for financial planning and ECL assessment. This alignment of financial and climate transition planning resulted in a £6 million increase in expected credit losses.
evidence.quote: NatWest Group continued to align its financial planning process with the climate transition planning process. This included adding climate policy and technology- related transition assumptions into NatWest Group's base case macroeconomic scenario used for financial planning and assessment of ECL in this IFRS 9 reporting period. This resulted in an increase in ECL of £6 million.

evidence.title: Climate risk management capability enhancement
evidence.summary: NatWest Group enhanced its in-house climate risk modelling capabilities and partnered with University of Exeter climate experts to create bespoke climate risk scenarios. The bank also began rolling out Climate Decisioning Framework tools and expanded climate risk policy scope to include nature-related risks.
evidence.quote: NatWest Group continued to enhance its in-house climate risk modelling capabilities, supporting the integration of climate risk within its capital adequacy (ICAAP), impairment (IFRS 9) and risk management processes. NatWest Group partnered with climate experts from the University of Exeter to create bespoke climate risk scenario narratives.
